derived_cause: parseReplayParams() is a zero-argument function whose only input is the ambient browser global window.location.search (frontend/src/lib/services/replayService.ts:57). It exposes no seam: no URL, query string or URLSearchParams argument, and no injectable source. The repository has exactly two test tiers and that shape fits neither. TIER 1, the unit tier: every unit test is a standalone script executed as `npx tsx <file>` under plain Node (.github/workflows/checks.yml:471, :540, :548, :567, :647), and frontend/package.json declares no test runner at all (devDependencies are playwright, svelte, svelte-check, typescript, vite; no vitest, jsdom or happy-dom anywhere). Node defines no `window` (verified locally: node v24.14.1, `typeof window` is 'undefined'), and no test file in frontend/src or frontend/scripts shims one (grep for globalThis.window / global.window / jsdom returns zero hits). A unit test that imported and called parseReplayParams() would therefore throw ReferenceError at replayService.ts:57 before reaching a single assertion, so no unit test can name it. TIER 2, the browser tier: frontend/scripts/replay_contract_gate.mjs drives the SHIPPED dist at a replay URL under Playwright and asserts external observables only (the character-for-character request URL, scheme-less rgs_url resolving to https at :752, currency/lang/amount demonstrably read from the query string at :473-477, the social Token/Currency label at :513-524). It never imports or names the function, and its query string always supplies currency, amount, lang, device and social (:112-121), so the defaulting branches are never entered. The repository's own two established workarounds for this exact shape confirm the mechanism by showing what parseReplayParams did NOT receive: (a) EXTRACTION OF THE PURE PART, applied to the identical construct in the locked rgsService.ts, where parseSessionParams reads `new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)` at :512 and the piece that needed proving was lifted into the pure argument-taking normaliseRgsUrl(raw: string) at :498-503, which is unit-tested in rgsService.contract.test.ts:63-67 under a header stating it matches replayService; and (b) RESTATEMENT IN THE TEST, applied at launchParams.test.ts:26-29, which re-declares App.svelte's token resolution over a hand-built `new URLSearchParams(string)` rather than calling the shipped function, exactly as replayRounds.test.ts:22-26 restates ReplayMode.svelte's mapping and records why. parseReplayParams got neither, so it remains one monolithic un-seamed function that mixes the window read with all the defaulting logic. CONSEQUENCE: every branch with no browser-visible observable is unproven by any test or gate: the mandatory-parameter throw (:67-71), the startsWith('http') https prefix (:73-75, whose only assertions in the repo test rgsService's parallel implementation, not this one), the currency default USD versus SC (:95), the social derivation via isVirtualCurrency (:96) which was itself a fixed compliance defect (TR-012, docs/records/reviews/REVIEW_TRACKER.md:99), the NaN/non-positive amount fallback to CURRENCY_SCALE (:102-103), and the lang/'desktop' defaults with the unchecked `as 'mobile' | 'desktop'` cast (:114-115). Bet Replay is a mandatory platform requirement (CLAUDE.md:408), which is where the COMPLIANCE weight comes from. The gap is a consequence of function shape plus harness capability, not of anyone omitting a test file: the function is only callable from a browser, and the browser tier tests observables rather than functions.
